title: B-2 colonel whispers about electrogravitics
summary: Richard Dolan tells of B-2 colonel whispers about electrogravitics, about 2008 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he leaned forward and he just whispered, "That's bullshit."

plain: An author and UFO historian named Richard Dolan says that at a 2008 conference in Las Vegas, he was talking with a colonel connected to the B-2, an American stealth bomber, about electrogravitics, an idea that electric charge could be used to push against gravity. The talk touched on a paper by a researcher named Paul LaViolette linking the B-2 to that idea, and on the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown. Dolan says the colonel leaned forward and just whispered, "That's bullshit," a moment he tells because it hints at what insiders might privately think about the bomber's secrets.
